Terms of Use

Effective 31 October 2026 (2026-10-31)

These terms cover your use of Winkaboo, the camera app made by CyberFruit Lab - FZCO, a free zone company in Dubai, United Arab Emirates (“we”, “us”). By downloading or using Winkaboo you agree to them. If you don’t agree, please don’t use the app. How we handle your data is in the Privacy Policy.

1. The free tier

Winkaboo is free to use with 5 shots a day. We may improve or change the app over time.

2. Winkaboo Unlimited

Winkaboo Unlimited is an optional auto-renewing subscription that gives you unlimited shots, with no daily limit. It comes in two plans:

  • Yearly: $39.99 a year in the US, with a 3-day free trial.
  • Weekly: $4.99 a week in the US.

The App Store shows your local price, which may differ by country and may include local taxes, in the app before you buy.

3. Free trial

The yearly plan starts with a 3-day free trial. The trial converts to a paid yearly subscription unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the trial ends. If you cancel in time you are not charged.

4. Payment, renewal and cancellation

  • Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase (or, with a free trial, when the trial ends).
  • Subscriptions renew automatically at the price of your plan unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your Apple Account is charged for the renewal within 24 hours before the period ends.
  • You can manage or cancel your subscription at any time in Settings › your name › Subscriptions on your iPhone. Cancelling stops the next renewal; you keep Winkaboo Unlimited until the end of the period you have already paid for.
  • Deleting the app does not cancel your subscription.

5. Refunds

Purchases are made through Apple, so refunds are handled by Apple under its policies. You can ask for one at reportaproblem.apple.com or through Apple Support. We can’t issue refunds ourselves.

6. Acceptable use

Use Winkaboo lawfully and with respect for other people. Please don’t:

  • photograph or film people in a way that breaks the law or their privacy;
  • copy, reverse-engineer or tamper with the app, or work around its limits or its subscription.

Please also look up from the screen: stay aware of your surroundings while you shoot.

7. Your photos belong to you

The photos, videos and reels you make with Winkaboo are yours. We don’t claim any ownership of them. They stay on your phone unless you save them to Photos or share them yourself; the Privacy Policy explains where everything is kept.

8. The app is provided as is

Winkaboo is provided “as is” and “as available”, without promises that it will be uninterrupted, error-free or that it will catch every moment or pick the frame you would have picked. To the extent the law allows, we are not liable for indirect or consequential losses arising from your use of the app. Nothing in these terms limits rights you have by law that can’t be limited.

9. Apple’s Standard EULA

Winkaboo is licensed to you under Apple’s Standard End User License Agreement, which applies in addition to these terms.

10. Changes to these terms

We may update these terms. The effective date at the top shows when they last changed. If you keep using Winkaboo after a change, you accept the updated terms.

11. Governing law

These terms, and any dispute arising out of or in connection with them or Winkaboo, are governed by the laws of the Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC), and the DIFC Courts have exclusive jurisdiction. If you are a consumer, this does not take away the protection of the laws of the country where you live that cannot be excluded by agreement, and you may also bring proceedings in the courts where you live wherever those laws give you that right. Before going to court, please write to us at hi@cyberfruit.ai so we can try to put things right. For the app licence itself, Apple’s Standard EULA sets its own law and courts.

12. Contact
